thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api eu-west-1 p95/p99 latency spike + queue growth. GPU pool 'eu-gpu-pool-2' at 98% alloc, autoscaler failing to create nodes (provisioner errors). Escalating to oncall.

sam (eng-sre, oncall): I'm on pager. seeing backlog up 45k reqs across host queues, many timeout 504s. Can folks jump in?

alex (eng-runtime): grabbing logs from runtime. initial signal is KV cache misses spiking and long tail model init. autoscaler logs show API rate-limit to cloud provider on instance create 429.

tina (eng-platform): hitting quota/circuit on autoscaler: "quotaExceeded" when calling instanceCreate. provider console shows short window of 403->429 bursts.

josh (eng-infra): on it — opening support ticket with provider. Also spinning up thin-provisioned pool in another zone (eu-west-2) as a fallback.

sam (eng-sre, oncall): Assigning incident severity P1. @alex @tina please coordinate immediate mitigations. @lee please collect customer-impact notes.

lee (support): Getting customer reports — 3 enterprise customers seeing 5xx rates spike, worst for long-generation requests (>2k tokens). Support ticket IDs: SUP-9481, SUP-9482. Communicating ETA 30m.

alex (eng-runtime): quick mitigation options: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized variants (gpu-lite) 2) enable aggressive prefix caching for repeated prompts 3) apply per-tenant soft rate limits to reduce pressure. I can flip (1) and (3) quickly if approved.

sam (eng-sre, oncall): Do it. Prioritize global availability over per-request fidelity. Execute fallback routing now.

ops-deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: routing-policy-update -> active (by alex)

alex (eng-runtime): routing switch rolled out to 20% -> 100% in ~4m. Observed drop in long-tail p99 for short queries but queue length still high due to a small number of heavy jobs holding KV caches.

tina (eng-platform): autoscaler retry loop appears to be livelocked: provisioner keeps requesting new instances, provider throttles, requests back off but no steady-state. I temporarily increased backoff to reduce thundering herd.

josh (eng-infra): eu-west-2 fallback pool creation started: images pulling, ETA ~8m. This will give capacity but we need routing to send traffic there.

sam (eng-sre, oncall): Can we route overflow to eu-west-2 once healthy? Also throttle very large requests (>1k tokens) to reduce head-of-line blocking.

alex (eng-runtime): implemented token-cutoff throttling: any request >1000 tokens returns 429-soft with instruction to retry with smaller size. Flipped in feature flag.

maria (product): we should notify affected customers about degraded perf and ask for temporary prompt size reduction. I'll draft a message.

lee (support): sending interim customer message now: "We're seeing increased latency in EU region; small workaround: reduce generation length or retry — we're routing traffic to alternate capacity; ETA ~30m."

sam (eng-sre, oncall): monitoring dashboards: queue length peaked at 52k, now down to 18k after routing + throttles. p95 dropped from 1.2s to 480ms for routed traffic; p99 still 7s for some tenants.

alex (eng-runtime): digging into which tenants have heavy KV cache churn — looks like tenant 'ad-intel' with many >1500-token batched requests. Their requests are single-shot heavy batches that prevent reuse of caches.

sam (eng-sre, oncall): @maria can we ask 'ad-intel' to pause large batch jobs? Lee help coordinate with account owner.

maria (product): reaching out to account rep now.

lee (support): update: ad-intel acknowledges and will throttle down for 1 hour. That should help.

josh (eng-infra): eu-west-2 pool healthy, added 12 GPUs. Routing rules updated to send 25% of new requests to that pool.

ops-deploy-bot: routing-policy-update -> 25% -> eu-west-2 (by josh)

sam (eng-sre, oncall): After eu-west-2 and throttles, backlog at 6k and falling. No new 504s reported in last 5m for non-heavy tenants. Good. Keep watch.

alex (eng-runtime): Postmortem notes in short: root cause chain: sudden traffic burst concentrated in EU + a handful of heavyweight requests -> KV cache churn + long model inits -> provisioner thrash -> provider rate-limit -> autoscaler livelock.

tina (eng-platform): Next steps: add autoscaler circuit breaker to stop retries after X failures and trigger manual operator flow; add multi-zone provisioning to spread instance creation; quota-awareness in scale plan.

josh (eng-infra): Also: pre-warm thin capacities in the evening for EU; file infra request for increased provider quota for instanceCreate.

sam (eng-sre, oncall): Immediate follow-ups (ACTIONS):
- (sam) Create incident page & timeline.
- (alex) Add temporary metric to detect heavy KV churn > threshold and auto-throttle those tenants.
- (tina) Add circuit-breaker to autoscaler; documented runbook for manual override.
- (josh) Complete quota request with provider and prewarm schedule.
- (maria/lee) Customer comms follow-up with affected accounts.

maria (product): Draft customer note ready, will send after final wording check.

sam (eng-sre, oncall): Declaring incident under active mitigation; not yet postmortem. Will hand to oncall shift in 2h if stable. Please add any logs/snippets here.

alex (eng-runtime): attaching key log snippets: ```
2024-11-03T02:14:22Z runtime: kv_cache miss rate jump 0.03 -> 0.78
2024-11-03T02:14:58Z autoscaler: request create instance -> 429 rateLimitExceeded
2024-11-03T02:16:10Z runtime: long model init 11.2s for model-x-4q
```

sam (eng-sre, oncall): Thanks all. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for the incident notes. Ping if backlog rises or errors resume. :thumbsup:
